title: Fields common to every kb item

schema_version.description: Major schema version; kb store migrate upgrades.

id.description: Assigned by kb: kind prefix and random suffix.

kind.description: Item kind; selects the kind schema.

summary.description: One to three sentences an LLM can read instead of the content. Shown in listings and search.

created.description: When, by whom and via what tool the item was made (not the date of its content).

access.description: Who may see it: public, collaboration, group, private.

subject.description: Slash-separated topic paths, e.g. detector/tpc/noise; reuse existing ones (kb ls --subjects).

valid.description: Validity interval of the content, as run ranges and/or a time window.

status.description: Confidence in the content: draft, unverified, verified (needs evidence), disputed.

identifiers.description: External identifiers: doi, arxiv, inspire, indico, cds, url ...

creators.description: Authors of the thing recorded (person refs or names).

date.description: The date the thing is known by: when it was published (else made). Fixed once written; qualified and correctable dates are in `dates`.

dates.description: Qualified dates of the thing, each saying what it dates; unlike `date`, they can be corrected. created: when it was made (written, drawn, produced); published: when it was made public (released, posted, presented); modified: when it last changed; accessed: when it was read or downloaded for this item; captured: when a photo or recording was taken.

supersedes.description: Items this one replaces (corrections, new versions).

retracts.description: Items this one withdraws without replacement.

derived_from.description: Inputs of a topic, view or derived item; stamped with digests.

evidence.description: Refs or URLs supporting the content; required for verified.

links.description: Typed relations to other items (a knowledge graph); each item shows the links to it under the inverse name. related is the untyped kind.

rel.description: What this item is to the other one.

license.description: SPDX identifier or a local term such as collaboration-internal.

renditions.description: Representations of the item's material and where each one's bytes are (in the store, a content store, a URL, an asset ...).

origin.description: Set on copies pushed from another store.

x.description: Free-form extensions. The only place unknown fields are allowed.
